name: Census of India 2011 — villages and towns
provider: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
layers: Village and town boundaries, population, households, sex ratio; block and district totals

name: District and community development block boundaries
provider: Census of India 2011 codes; boundaries compiled by D.I.S.H.A.R.I
layers: District and block boundaries, area summaries

name: Island inventory of the Sundarbans
provider: Survey of India and NRIS 1:50,000 layers (attributes); island polygons compiled by D.I.S.H.A.R.I
licence: As published by the Survey of India
layers: Island names, category, land area, hazards, nearest port

name: WorldPop population 2020 (100 m)
layers: Population density per hexagon

name: VIIRS night-time lights
provider: NOAA / Earth Observation Group, Colorado School of Mines
layers: Night-time lights

name: OpenStreetMap
layers: Rivers, canals, water bodies, roads and paths (walking network), ghats and jetties, place names, services, buildings

name: World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA)
layers: Sundarbans National Park, wildlife sanctuaries, reserve-forest compartments, World Heritage and Ramsar designations, legal status class

name: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200
layers: Land-cover map and land-cover shares per hexagon

name: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2
layers: True- and false-colour composites 2010 and 2025, land surface temperature, shoreline positions

name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI
licence: Copernicus free and open data licence
layers: NDVI, NDWI and MNDWI composites, monthly NDVI phenology, mangrove classification

name: Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR
licence: Copernicus free and open data licence
layers: Radar backscatter (VV, VH) and radar water mask

name: MODIS Terra / Aqua (MOD13 NDVI, MOD11 land surface temperature)
layers: Yearly greenness 2000–2025, seasonal land surface temperature

name: JRC Global Surface Water
provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre (Pekel et al., 2016)
licence: Free and open (cite Pekel et al., 2016)
layers: Water occurrence, permanent and seasonal water 2000, 2010, 2020

name: SRTM digital elevation model
layers: Elevation, slope, shaded terrain

name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
layers: Elevation (second model)

name: CHIRPS v2 rainfall
provider: Climate Hazards Center, University of California, Santa Barbara
layers: Annual and monsoon rainfall, rainfall trends

name: IBTrACS v4 tropical cyclone tracks
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
layers: Distance to cyclone tracks, cyclone track length

name: Satellite sea-surface temperature, ocean colour and ocean reanalysis
provider: Satellite and reanalysis ocean products (seasonal means)
layers: Sea-surface temperature by season, chlorophyll-a, salinity, surface currents, sea surface height

name: Tiger occurrence records 2004–2025
layers: Tiger records per hexagon; tiger habitat model training

name: Chital (spotted deer) occurrence records
layers: Prey records per hexagon; prey habitat model training

name: D.I.S.H.A.R.I analysis products
provider: D.I.S.H.A.R.I research (machine-learning pipeline v2, release v2026.10.05)
layers: Mangrove extent 2016 / 2020 / 2025, surface-water frequency, permanent and tidal water, river channels and creeks, navigable water at low and high tide, shoreline change, tiger and prey habitat models (spatial cross-validation), conservation priority, human exposure, habitat pressure, habitat patches and corridors, boat-access distance

name: Open-Meteo weather forecast and marine sea level
layers: Weather forecast, sea level and tide times

name: Online basemaps
provider: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics and the GIS User Community; OpenStreetMap contributors; CARTO; OpenTopoMap; EOX IT Services (Sentinel-2 cloudless, contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data); NASA GIBS
licence: Provider terms (attribution shown on the map)
layers: Basemap gallery
